title: Zebra holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- zebra body -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="62" rx="24" ry="17" fill="#f4f4f8"/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d="M30 50 Q36 62 30 74" stroke="#3a3a55" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M40 47 Q46 62 40 77" stroke="#3a3a55" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M50 47 Q56 62 50 77" stroke="#3a3a55" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M60 50 Q66 62 60 74" stroke="#3a3a55" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="30" y="74" width="6" height="16" rx="2" fill="#f4f4f8"/>
  <rect x="30" y="80" width="6" height="4" fill="#3a3a55"/>
  <rect x="54" y="74" width="6" height="16" rx="2" fill="#f4f4f8"/>
  <rect x="54" y="80" width="6" height="4" fill="#3a3a55"/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d="M22 56 L30 38 L44 44 L36 62 Z" fill="#f4f4f8"/>
  <path d="M26 44 L34 40" stroke="#3a3a55" stroke-width="4"/>
  <path d="M24 52 L33 47" stroke="#3a3a55" stroke-width="4"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="34" rx="14" ry="11" fill="#f4f4f8"/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d="M20 38 Q14 30 22 26 Q16 20 26 22" stroke="#3a3a55" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx="21" cy="38" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#d8d8e6"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="36" r="1.8" fill="#2a2a44"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#2a2a44"/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="31" r="2.5" fill="#2a2a44"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="30" r="0.9" fill="#aab4ff"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="27" cy="22" rx="3.5" ry="6" fill="#f4f4f8" transform="rotate(-15 27 22)"/>
  <ellipse cx="27" cy="23" rx="1.8" ry="3.5" fill="#3a3a55" transform="rotate(-15 27 23)"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="23" rx="3.5" ry="6" fill="#f4f4f8" transform="rotate(15 40 23)"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="24" rx="1.8" ry="3.5" fill="#3a3a55" transform="rotate(15 40 24)"/>
  <!-- heart in front of body -->
  <path d="M70 44 C70 37 80 37 80 44 C80 37 90 37 90 44 C90 54 80 62 80 62 C80 62 70 54 70 44 Z" fill="#ff4f7d"/>
  <path d="M75 44 C75 42 80 42 80 46" stroke="#ffb0c8" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- little hoof arm holding heart -->
  <path d="M66 58 Q70 54 73 50" stroke="#f4f4f8" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="49" rx="3.5" ry="3" fill="#d8d8e6"/>
</svg>
